applicable_signals.statement: Use native HTML controls and form behavior when they can express the task safely.

module1.plain_explanation: Shape a sparse metric world whose untouched cells remain mathematical space while authored changes become portable patches and components.
module1.why_it_matters: Shape a sparse metric world whose untouched cells remain mathematical space while authored changes become portable patches and components. Blank is the default and authored content is opt-in. Presentation frames are never world truth. Imported or unknown-provenance work is never relabelled self-made. The base source and raster remain immutable; visual approval, game installation and canonical promotion stay explicit.

applicable_signals.fit_check: Verify every interactive state at keyboard focus, including sticky headers, overlays, and dialogs.
applicable_signals.statement: Keyboard focus must remain visible and must not be hidden by interface content.

applicable_signals.fit_check: Check touch targets and provide a non-drag path for spatial or direct-manipulation controls.
applicable_signals.statement: Pointer targets need sufficient size, and dragging interactions need an alternative where the criterion applies.

applicable_signals.statement: Interactive components need programmatically determinable names, roles, values, states, and status changes.
